limitations: Exact for a fixed output port, Haar complex interferometers, distinct singly occupied inputs, and pure unentangled internal states. Does not cover summed full-bunching probabilities, loss, noisy optical devices, mixed or entangled source states. Priority remains subject to independent literature verification.
scientific_integrity: The scattering and distinguishability factorizations are attributed to preexisting primary papers. The new mathematical result asserted is the explicit joint photon/mode-count large-deviation law, and its strict typical-to-average exponent. Classical Dirichlet and logarithmic-spacing probability results are recognized as underlying prior tools; numerical tests are not represented as proofs.
title: Haar full-bunching has a sharp large-deviation law and an exponential mean–typical gap
